name: Marija Kovačić
bio:
Marija Kovačić's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. Originally a project manager for a shipping company, she was tasked with handling the logistics for a small rally team competing in the Balkan Rally Championship. The fast pace and high stakes environment ignited a passion she never knew she possessed. She made the leap from general logistics to specializing in motorsport, quickly becoming known for her meticulous planning and unwavering commitment to deadlines.

At Nostalgia Racing, Marija is the backbone of their logistical operations. Her organizational skills are unparalleled, and she thrives under pressure, ensuring that every component, from tires to telemetry equipment, arrives precisely when and where it's needed. She is a firm believer in proactive problem-solving and has a knack for anticipating potential bottlenecks before they arise. Her blend of traditional methods and a surprising openness to innovative logistical solutions sets her apart.

While she appreciates the nostalgia of the team's name, she is always looking for ways to streamline operations and make the most out of modern technology. She is driven by the desire to see the team succeed and will do whatever it takes to keep everything on track, and to perfection.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, neatly styled in a classic bob
physical.description: A woman of medium height with a focused and determined expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with meticulously handwritten schedules.
Insists on using a physical map alongside GPS for route planning.
Has a specific ritual for packing her travel bag before each race, believing it brings good luck.
